從找不到順手的工具開始: A tool Josh wanted to use
換過工作, Josh 還是找不到用得順手的專案管理工具。於是他決定自己做, 這就: Even after changing jobs, Josh had not found a project management tool that felt right to use. He decided to build his own. That was the beginning of Pavenro.
Pavenro 把任務、團隊交辦與工時紀錄放在同一個工作空間。正式工作用任務追蹤: Pavenro keeps issues, team assignments and time records in one workspace. Track planned work as issues, and keep smaller tasks in notes until they need project tracking.
紙條與任務有什麼不同？: How are notes different from issues?
紙條用來速記與交辦, 可以回覆、轉交、完成或退回。需要排進專案追蹤時, 再從紙條: Use notes for quick reminders and assignments, with replies, handoffs, completion and returns. Turn a note into an issue when it needs project tracking, retaining its content and source.
同一個帳號可以切換有資格存取的工作空間, 分別處理各空間的專案與紙條。切換不會合: One account can switch between workspaces it is eligible to access, with separate projects and notes in each. Switching does not merge boards or time reports.
工時由本人填報在任務上, 再依專案、成員或日期查看。填報紀錄不是自動計時或產能評: You log time on issues yourself, then review the records by project, member or date. These are reported records, not automatic tracking or productivity scores. You can edit only your own valid entries.
能串接自己的程式或 AI 工具嗎？: Can I connect my scripts or AI tools?
可以使用個人 API Token 與公開 REST API 依契約串接。Toke: Use personal API tokens and the public REST API to build an integration against the documented contract. Tokens remain limited by your current access and their bound workspace. Not every UI action has a public API.
註冊並驗證信箱後, 可以建立工作空間與專案；如果收到邀請, 先確認邀請再加入。已: Register and verify your email, then create a workspace and project. If you receive an invitation, confirm it before joining. Already have an account? Sign in at the top of the page.
